args.title: Juniper Labware: Warehouse automation in 2026 — three-bullet summary
args.body:
- Newsletter (Juniper Labware, "Warehouse automation in 2026"): this week's issue focuses on warehouse automation trends for 2026.
- Linked article (blog.juniper.example/2026/warehouse): pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, but integration took twice as long as planned.
- Companion piece (insights.juniper.example/warehouse/companion): the biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.
